case.title: Which replication task owned the COPY that became inactive after an idle timeout?
case.title_zh: 空闲超时后失活的 COPY，属于哪个复制提交任务？

findings.observation: One PgJDBC42.7.13/JDK21.0.1 idle logical-replication read on private PostgreSQL17.1/test_decoding throws PSQLException55000: Tried to write to an inactive copy operation. The status interval is configured to3000ms and the stream reports closed. Target and JDI collector exit0; server shutdown is logged. Source review, artifact preparation, build and execution take166.89s.
findings.interpretation: CoroPerf joins the actual FutureTask constructor object1133 to four later diagnostic observations, recovering startChangefeed absent from the native/current exception stack. An explicit JDI resource observer binds that Task to stream1183 and CopyDual1184, independently checked against application-held Task/stream references. The same operation appears in the SocketTimeoutException, unlock entry, wrapped read failure and subsequent inactive-COPY failure. Seven timeout records are rethrows of one exception object1196, not seven timeouts. The source already documents the root cause; the additional evidence is historical ownership and the same-operation event sequence.
findings.limits: The logical output plugin is test_decoding rather than wal2json, within the report explicitly described as plugin-agnostic. A real idle logical stream and unmodified42.7.13 driver are used, not physical replication or a thrown-error stand-in. A single controlled FutureTask supplies the component submission context; startChangefeed is its helper, not an original application registration. Resource identity requires the explicitly added observer and is not inferred from Task ancestry. Event-record order is captured, not physical timestamps; unlock is observed at entry, not exit. No duration, uninstrumented timing, alternate driver/plugin/interval or fix validation is claimed. Only one successful read workload ran.

case.symptom_zh: PgJDBC42.7.13/JDK21.0.1 对私有 PostgreSQL17.1/test_decoding 的一次真实空闲逻辑复制读取，抛出 SQLSTATE55000 的 PSQLException：Tried to write to an inactive copy operation。状态间隔配置为3000毫秒，复制流报告已关闭。目标和 JDI 采集器均退出0，数据库日志确认关闭；源码、制品、构建与运行共166.89秒。
case.reasoning_zh: CoroPerf 将真实 FutureTask 构造对象1133 接到四个后续诊断观察，恢复原生异常栈缺少的 startChangefeed 提交入口。明确增加的 JDI 资源观察把该任务绑定到 stream1183 与 CopyDual1184，并用应用实际持有的 Task/stream 引用独立核对。同一 COPY 出现在 SocketTimeoutException、unlock 入口、包装后的读取错误和随后失活错误中。七条超时记录是异常对象1196 的重抛，并非七次超时。来源已说明根因，新增证据是历史所属任务及同一操作的事件顺序。
case.limits_zh: 使用 test_decoding 替代 wal2json，仍在报告明确声明插件无关的逻辑复制场景内。真实空闲逻辑流与未修改的42.7.13驱动运行，没有物理复制或手工抛错替代。一个真实 FutureTask 提供组件提交上下文，startChangefeed 是辅助入口，不是原始应用注册点。资源身份依赖额外观察，不能从 Task 祖先关系推断。仅有记录顺序，无物理事件时间戳；unlock 观察在入口而非出口。不声称耗时、无采集器时序、多版本、插件、间隔或修复验证。成功读取工作负载只有一次。

limitations: test_decoding replaces wal2json in a report explicitly described as plugin-agnostic; still real logical replication.
Caller entry startChangefeed is the component submission helper, not an original application registration.
Actual Task and resource identity captured; event order only, no physical event timestamps or unlock-return observation.
The report already documents the root cause; tool contribution is historical ownership and the operation-bound error sequence.
No alternate version, plugin, interval or fix validation.

source_metadata.scope: One PgJDBC42.7.13 idle logical replication read on private PostgreSQL17.1/test_decoding, configured status interval3000ms. Driver and protocol code unmodified.
source_metadata.extra_resource_observer: V3PGReplicationStream constructor CopyDual argument and QueryExecutorImpl read/write/unlock argument observed directly, with independent application FutureTask/stream field identities. Not inferred from Task ancestry.
source_metadata.deduplication: Seven rethrow records carry the same SocketTimeoutException object1196; wrapper and inactive-operation exceptions each have two records. Normalize one observation per distinct exception object, retaining raw events unchanged.
source_metadata.ordering_limit: UNLOCK captures method entry, not its exit or the exact instant of state assignment. No latency or uninstrumented timing claim.
